seam: M3Features.isOn (control, M3Features.FRAME_OVERLAY) at the overlay timer, the retain decision and the overlay paint

M3Themes.follows (control): M3Features.isOn (control, M3Features.THEME_PROVIDER), or no theme-provider key configured for the class chain (M3Themes.apply is the opt-in); read by M3ThemeApplier for every control of an apply and a reset

M3Language.follows (widget): M3Features.isOn (widget, M3Features.LANGUAGE_SWITCH), or no language-switch key configured for the class chain (M3Language.setLocale is the opt-in); read by the relabel pass and the RTL flip
